entry.title: Follow RSI · 2026-11-07 · Collection and review bulletin
entry.summary: Collection and review bulletin published; no new papers were included. Collection and review record before publication: All 12 enabled sources were attempted at 08:07–08:11 Asia/Shanghai. Today’s HF board was not ready (available through Nov 6); the complete Nov 5 and Nov 6 boards contained 39 and 31 papers. Reconciliation added 46 identities and four recommendation dates; three-round review supported two inclusions and 48 scope exclusions, retaining their original HF dates. Three arXiv queries succeeded with zero results; 13 GitHub repositories had zero releases in the source window. All five RSS feeds succeeded, returning 58 window entries. S2 citations yielded seven window entries from the first 100 raw records before 429 throttling; citation continuation and author tracking were not fully collected. This is a collection and review brief, not a claim of new papers or no updates for the whole day.

entry.title: Follow RSI · 2026-11-08 · Collection and review bulletin
entry.summary: Collection and review bulletin published; no new papers were included. Collection and review record before publication: All 12 sources were attempted at 08:04–08:13 Asia/Shanghai. Today’s HF board was not ready; the latest available complete board, Nov 6, contained 32 papers, with late member Coca-Cola excluded. Nineteen new identities yielded five individually reviewed papers for supplements dated Nov 4 or Nov 5, 13 exclusions, and Evolver pending evidence. Another 443 historical records were reviewed: 15 historical backlog inclusions, 419 exclusions and nine scope boundaries. Including source retries, the combined 467-row review has 434 exclusions, 15 historical backlog decisions and 18 deferrals. Five RSS feeds returned 59 window records; 13 GitHub repositories had no window releases. Three arXiv queries timed out or returned 429; anonymous S2 throttling left parts of the source uncollected. Older papers were not relabeled as new today. This is a collection snapshot, not a claim that no later updates exist.
